brief:
**BLUF:** In Tazewell County, VA, public schools are marking National School Lunch Week and a water project is being streamlined to better meet local needs. In the immediate region, multiple arrests and charges were reported in Mercer County, WV (including a Bluefield man facing strangulation and child abuse allegations and a driver accused of fleeing troopers on I-77), alongside a fatal interstate crash in West Virginia. Broader area notes include new STEM centers in McDowell County, WV, and average gas prices of $4.24 per gallon statewide in West Virginia.[[1]](https://www.wvnews.com/news/wvnews/driver-accused-of-fleeing-state-trooper-on-i-77-in-mercer-county/article_283ed642-a467-43c9-b7b6-5e9f4242fd40.html)

## LAW ENFORCEMENT AND COURTS
**Core (Tazewell County, VA / Bluefield VA / Mercer County, WV):** Nothing reported in the last 24 hours.

**Region (nearest first):** 
- Bluefield, WV (Mercer County): A Bluefield man was charged with strangulation and child abuse after an alleged attack.[[2]](https://www.lootpress.com/driver-accused-of-fleeing-trooper-on-i-77-striking-guardrail-in-mercer-county/)
- Bluefield, WV (Mercer County): A Bluefield man was accused of strangling his wife and attacking their daughter who intervened (reported Oct. 11).
- Mercer County, WV: A driver (Christopher McCravey) was accused of fleeing a West Virginia State Police trooper on I-77, striking a guardrail, reckless driving, and obstructing; the incident occurred Oct. 4 near mile marker 20 but charges were detailed in recent reporting.[[1]](https://www.wvnews.com/news/wvnews/driver-accused-of-fleeing-state-trooper-on-i-77-in-mercer-county/article_283ed642-a467-43c9-b7b6-5e9f4242fd40.html)
- Fayette County, WV: A man was accused of threatening his girlfriend and throwing a phone from a vehicle.[[3]](https://www.wvnstv.com/news/crime/mercer-county-crime/bench-warrant-list-released-by-the-bluefield-west-virginia-police-department-54/)
- Summers County, WV: A man was accused of threatening his mother with a knife and assault.[[4]](https://x.com/WV511South/status/2106587686324560216)

## GOVERNMENT AND POLITICS
**Core:** Tazewell County Public Schools celebrated National School Lunch Week. A water project is being streamlined to meet county needs (Bluefield Daily Telegraph reporting).[[5]](https://www.centralillinoisproud.com/tag/tazewell-county-sheriffs-office/)

**Region:** A digital system will help some West Virginia Medicaid recipients navigate upcoming work requirements (Bluefield Daily Telegraph). Four STEM centers opened in McDowell County, WV (Bluefield Daily Telegraph). Southern West Virginia Community and Technical College (SWCC) is mourning the passing of founding President Dr. Charles R. King.[[6]](https://www.wvva.com/2026/10/08/what-do-deputy-sheriffs-do-tazewell-county-ride-along-offers-insight/)

## ECONOMY AND OTHER
**Core/Region:** West Virginia gas prices averaged $4.24 per gallon (Bluefield Daily Telegraph). Bonnie’s Buses offered mammograms in Bluefield, Gary, Hamlin, Romney, Mt. Storm, and West Milford, WV. For most of this decade, Southwest and Southside Virginia have had some of the fastest wage growth in the U.S. (Cardinal News). The Granada Theater in Beckley, WV, area is hosting a Haunted History Walk.[[7]](https://uspolicedepartments.org/virginia/tazewell/tazewell-county-sheriff%27s-office-tazewell-virginia)
